active.title: The Forge of Spells
active.summary: Wave Echo Cave, east of Phandalin, contains the Forge of Spells — a Phalorm-era enchanting forge. The Black Spider wants it. The Lords' Alliance wants it secured. The Rockseeker brothers found the entrance before Gundren was taken.
objectives: DONE (session 5): map recovered — in Gundren's keeping
Reach the cave before the Black Spider does
active.obstacles: The Spider doesn't yet know his messenger failed. Cave location now in party's hands via the map. Nundro and Tharden still unaware they're hunted.
active.secret_truth: The Forge of Spells is still functional. The Black Spider plans to use it to arm a military force. Gundren's brothers Nundro and Tharden are camped near the cave entrance — fate unknown.

completed.title: Rescue Gundren Rockseeker
completed.summary: Gundren was taken by Cragmaw goblins and transported to Cragmaw Castle, north of Phandalin, on orders from the Black Spider — a drow agent who wants Gundren's map to Wave Echo Cave.
completed.obstacles: Unknown number of Cragmaw goblins and their leadership at the castle. The Black Spider's network is watching.
completed.rewards: Sildar has offered unspecified Lords' Alliance support. Gundren would owe the party significantly.
completed.secret_truth: The Black Spider is a drow named Nezznar working for Lolth's faction. He wants the Forge of Spells inside Wave Echo Cave. Gundren's brothers may still be at the cave entrance.
completed.resolution: COMPLETED session 5 — Gundren freed from Grol's tower (Grol bargained: life+castle for the ambush route), map recovered at the plank-bridge ambush, doppelganger courier Vyerith captured alive.

hooks.summary: Gundren Rockseeker hired the party to escort supplies to Phandalin from Neverwinter.
hooks.consequence_if_ignored: Gundren remains missing; the Cragmaw threat grows.
